notes:
CRM notes:
- Prospect: mid-size clinical documentation vendor focused on hospital CPT/encounter notes and imaging reports.
- Primary driver: improve clinician search relevance (RAG) + strict audit trail for PHI access.
- Wants embeddings + reranker flow: vector retrieval -> lightweight re-ranker on cached candidates -> final answer assembly. Emphasis on deterministic rerank reproducibility for audits.
- Indexing scale: ~50M documents initially, plan to grow to 200M within 12-18 months. Expecting ~180M embedding vectors post-preprocessing.
- Performance targets: 100 QPS baseline; spikes to 400 QPS during morning rounds. P90 end-to-end RAG latency goal: <=250ms for retrieval+rerank; prefer <=200ms for reranker microservice. Budget sensitivity: aiming for <$0.008 per user-query (all-in).
- Model preferences: open models preferred for on-prem (quantized Llama-family or similar); looking at Redwood for optimized kernels + fallbacks to smaller re-ranker models to reduce cost.
- Security: PHI in scope. Must have VPC/private peering, bring-your-own-key via HSM/KMS, session- and token-level audit logs retained 7+ years for specific workflows, support for SSO/SAML, fine-grained RBAC.
- \"Quote from CISO\": \"We cannot allow any PHI to transit public endpoints without encryption and proof of access logging.\"
- Operational asks: routing/fallback policy (dedicated->hosted fallback not acceptable for PHI), ability to pin model versions per environment, per-route cost/latency telemetry.
- POC success metrics: recall@k for clinical synonyms >=0.85 vs baseline, rerank reorder precision +25%, end-to-end P90 latency <=300ms during 100 QPS test.
- Connected artifacts: pricing deck + security_faq in Drive. Jira tickets opened for HSM requirements (RWD-5132) and network peering (RWD-5290).
- Next meeting: security deep dive scheduled; procurement evaluating SOW template.
- Short fragments expected: 'need MSA clause for PHI residency', 'can you provide kernel/quantization guidance for our Nvidia A100 fleet', 'who owns the KV cache in Private deployment?'
